# openmetadata_query Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata query by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_query" "recent_orders" {
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.recent_orders"
}

output "recent_orders_query_text" {
  value = data.openmetadata_query.recent_orders.query
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Query fully qualified name, in the form service.name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Query UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Query name.
- `query` (String) SQL text of the query.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the database service the query runs against.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
